title: 第12章 道门鬼市
slug: 掠天记全本免费-掠天记最新章节列表
content_zh:
到了这一天，方行准备好了提前想了好准备携带的东西，又取出了万罗鬼面，戴在脸上之后，灵气灌入，立刻感觉到，一道奇异的力量从万罗鬼面里面涌了出来，直流入他的全身，然后，他的全身骨骼啪啪作响，身形竟然强行拉高了三尺，变得和一个成年人相似了。
不过由于他本来身量就小，此时看起来也是非常的瘦削。
此时此刻，方行看起来便是一个眉眼精明的年青人模样了，大约二十来岁，模样并不英俊，也不算丑，只能说显得很普通，是很容易被遗忘的那种人。
方行又试着说了说话，，感觉声音嘶哑，浑厚，也像个成年人一般，这才满意的点了点头，穿上了从胖道人那里借来的道袍，大摇大摆往鬼市的地点赶去。
山谷之中，来来往往，也没人关注这样一个人的进出。
鬼市地点在距离外门弟子距离区十里左右的一个小山谷里，方行赶到的时候，已经明月初升，来到这处山谷，却见谷口站着两个蒙面的修士，都是灵动一重，阴恻恻的望着来人，见方行走来，其中一个人便上前一步，低声道：“师兄来这里所为何事？”
方行见他们防守如此严谨，也有些意外，不过他很快冷笑了一声，道：“没东西换谁来这破地方，大家都是明白人，就别装了，希望今天的鬼市别让我失望才好！”
两个守卫的人对视了一眼，其中一个低声道：“师兄噤声，这事被道门晓得了，大家都落不着好……”
方行嗤笑了一声，道：“道门若想知道这鬼市的事，凭咱们这些人，如何瞒得过他们？嘿嘿，无非就是道门不想管，睁一只眼闭一只眼罢了，你们何必如此紧张？”
两个守卫闻言大奇，感觉这是个明白人，疑心尽去，便放他进去了。
方行对此冷笑，这点道理对他来说一点也没难度，他已经从胖道人那里打听的差不多了。
道门规矩虽大，却从来不会将事情做绝，若不是道门对这鬼市的事情睁一只眼，闭一只眼，随便派个长老过来整治一番，这鬼市也就开不下去了。
这一次鬼市来的人大都是一些道门四个月前拜进来的新弟子，最多也只会有一些灵动二重的师兄们加入进来罢了，其他修为更高的青云宗弟子们是看不上这个鬼市的，说白了这次过来的都是一些菜鸟们，虽然表现的紧张兮兮，如临大敌，但轻轻松松就忽悠过去了。
毕竟这样的鬼市，大家都不是很熟，无法提前限定身份，混进来难度实在不高。
本来只说有十几人参加的鬼市，此时的山谷内，却已经聚集了二十多人，想来除了方行，还有好几个外人是听说了这件事之后，主动加入进来的。每个人都选择了一个自认为安全的角落，把自己打扮的严严实实，生恐别人认出自己来，双目炯炯，盯着现场。
“诸位师兄弟，多余的话某家也不多说了，能来到这里，想必大家心里都是有数的，有什么要换的东西，就赶紧拿出来吧，此事宜快不宜慢，早些换完了回去才是正经！”
有一个蒙面的黑衣人站了出来说道，看样子是个晓事的。
“不错，就由老弟我先来吧，说句实话，知道你们这些人大都是前不久刚进来的师弟们，手头上最缺的也就是灵石，好巧不巧，我手上就有六块多余的灵石，正打算转让给你们，道门兑换灵石的价格，是一百两金子换一块，在我这里，只换八十两金子，谁想要就开口！”
一个身材瘦削的汉子走到了场间，将五六块亮晶晶的红色灵石放在了大青石上。
旁边立刻一阵耸动，好几个人颇为意动，毕竟一块灵石就能省二十两金子。

“我……我要先检查灵石……”
有一个蒙着面的胖子举手说道，众人目光立刻看向了他。
“嘿嘿，随便检查，还能有错不成？”
瘦削汉子嘿嘿笑着，双手一摊，做出了一个随便检查的姿势。
方行听他说话声，就觉得非常眼熟，忍不住用阴阳神魔鉴看了他一眼，顿时心里一乐，原来还是个熟人，这瘦削汉子不是别人，正是一个月前自己在法器阁见过的大耗子精，想来也只有他这种处于油水丰厚位置的人，手头上才会有这么多的灵石转让吧！

content_en:
On this day, Fang Xing prepared the things he had thought about in advance, and took out the Wanluo Ghost Mask. After putting it on his face, the spiritual energy poured in, and he immediately felt a strange power pouring out of the Wanluo Ghost Mask and flowing straight into his body. Then, the bones all over his body crackled, and his figure was forcibly stretched three feet taller, becoming similar to an adult.
However, because he was originally small, he looked very thin at this time.
At this moment, Fang Xing looked like a young man with shrewd features, about 20 years old. He was not handsome, nor ugly. He could only be said to be very ordinary, the kind of person who is easily forgotten.
Fang Xing tried to speak again, and his voice felt hoarse and rich, like an adult. Then he nodded with satisfaction, put on the Taoist robe borrowed from the fat Taoist, and swaggered to the ghost market.
In the valley, no one paid attention to the coming and going of such a person.
The ghost market is located in a small valley about ten miles away from the outer disciples. When Fang Xing arrived, the moon was already rising. When he arrived at the valley, he saw two masked monks standing at the entrance of the valley. They were both agile and looked at the visitor with a sinister look. As they walked forward, one of them stepped forward and whispered: "Brother, why are you here?"
Fang Xing was a little surprised when he saw how rigorous their defense was, but he quickly sneered and said, "Who can come to this miserable place without anything? We all are sensible people, so stop pretending. I hope today's ghost market won't disappoint me!"
The two guards looked at each other, and one of them whispered: "Senior brother, be silent, the Taoist sect has found out about this, and everyone will be left behind..."
Fang Xing sneered and said: "If the Daomen want to know about this ghost market, how can we hide it from them? Hehe, it's just that the Daomen don't want to care about it and just turn a blind eye. Why are you so nervous?"
The two guards were surprised when they heard this. They felt that this was a sensible person, and their suspicions were gone, so they let him in.
Fang Xing sneered at this. This truth was not difficult for him at all. He had already learned about it from the fat Taoist.
Although the Taoist sect has great rules, it never does things absolutely. If the Taoist sect hadn't turned a blind eye to the ghost market's affairs and randomly sent an elder to rectify it, the ghost market would not have been able to continue operating.
Most of the people who came to the ghost market this time were new disciples from the Taoist sect who had joined four months ago. At most, there would only be some spiritual brothers of the second level joining. Other Qingyun Sect disciples with higher cultivation levels did not look down on this ghost market. To put it bluntly, the people who came this time were all rookies. Although they acted nervously, as if they were facing a formidable enemy, they were easily fooled.
After all, no one is very familiar with this kind of ghost market and cannot define their identity in advance, so it is not difficult to get in.
The ghost market was originally said to be attended by only a dozen people, but at this time, more than twenty people had gathered in the valley. It seems that besides Fang Xing, there were several outsiders who took the initiative to join in after hearing about this incident. Everyone chose a corner that they thought was safe, and dressed themselves up for fear that others would recognize them. They stared at the scene with bright eyes.
"Fellow brothers, I won't say any more. Being here, I think everyone knows it. If you have anything to change, take it out as soon as possible. This matter should be done quickly rather than slowly. It is more serious to finish the change and go back as soon as possible!"
A masked man in black stood up and said, he seemed to be knowledgeable.
"Yes, let me go first. To be honest, I know that most of you are junior brothers who just came in not long ago. The thing you are most short of is the spirit stones. By coincidence, I have six extra spirit stones on hand, and I am planning to transfer them to you. The Taoist exchange price for the spirit stones isThe price is one hundred taels of gold for one piece. In my case, it only exchanges for eighty taels of gold. Anyone who wants it can ask! "
A thin man walked to the venue and placed five or six shiny red spiritual stones on the big bluestone.
There was an immediate commotion nearby, and several people were quite moved. After all, one spiritual stone can save twenty taels of gold.
"I...I want to check the spirit stone first..."
A masked fat man raised his hand and said, and everyone immediately looked at him.
"Hey, if you just check it, can you still make mistakes? "
The thin man chuckled, spread his hands, and made a gesture of casual inspection.
When Fang Xing heard his voice, he felt that he looked very familiar. He couldn't help but look at him with the Yin-Yang God and Demon Mirror, and he felt happy. It turned out that he was an acquaintance. This thin man was none other than the big rat that he had seen in the Magical Artifact Pavilion a month ago. Only someone in a lucrative position like him could have so many spiritual stones to transfer!
